title: Critical and near-critical XY scaling and BKT universality

result.label: Critical and near-critical XY scaling and BKT universality
result.statement: For the square-lattice nearest-neighbor cosine XY model, proves critical axis correlations C (r) Ar^ -1/4 ( r)^ 1/8 and the Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless essential singularity - ( ) B, with A,B 0 after the free-box thermodynamic limit. For finite square-symmetric interactions containing nearest neighbors, discrete Gaussian heights converge to Gaussian fields throughout the rough phase, including its threshold, along geometric torus sizes. Critical center-magnetization and spin-field conclusions retain their stated height, renormalization, and field-input assumptions.
